Journey: Share. Track: console.

Outcome
A steward shares only part of a study, for example the resting-state runs of participants over sixty, and the recipient gets exactly that.

Acceptance
1. From a frozen selection, Share this subset prepares a view through the existing route, shows its preview (files, participants, columns disclosed) and accepts it as its own release.
2. The subset release is shared through the SHARE1 dialog. The recipient sees and downloads the subset only. The parent study, its other releases and any hidden columns stay invisible.
3. The study page lists the subsets derived from it, each with who has access.
4. A selection that includes data types with no view rules says so plainly instead of failing.
